news.titleEn: Fed approves interest rate hike, signals one more to come this year
news.conclusionEn: The Fed raised rates by 25 basis points to 3.75%-4%, its first hike since July 2023.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储加息25个基点至3.75%-4%，为2023年7月以来首次加息。
news.whyEn: It marks a policy reversal that raises borrowing costs for households, businesses and governments worldwide.
news.whyZh: 政策转向推高全球家庭、企业和政府的借贷成本。
news.detailEn: The decision was unanimous and is the first major move under new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who said inflation is too high and has been for too long. Inflation has picked up this year, partly because of the war with Iran. The Fed signalled one more hike could come before year-end. The move could put Warsh at odds with President Trump, who appointed him after pushing for lower rates.
news.detailZh: 这次决议全票通过，是新任美联储主席沃什上任后的首个重大动作，他称通胀「过高且持续太久」。今年通胀回升，部分原因是对伊朗的战争。美联储暗示年内可能再加息一次。此举可能使沃什与曾施压要求降息并提名他的特朗普产生分歧。

news.conclusionEn: Wall Street ended a volatile week mixed as the 10-year Treasury yield topped 5%.
news.conclusionZh: 华尔街在动荡一周后涨跌不一，美国10年期国债收益率突破5%。
news.whyEn: Yields at their highest since 2007 raise financing costs and pressure equity valuations.
news.whyZh: 收益率升至2007年以来最高，抬高融资成本并压制股票估值。
news.detailEn: The Dow fell 95.40 points, or 0.18%, to 51,682.64, while the S&P 500 rose 0.17% to 7,650.50 and the Nasdaq gained 0.39% to 26,522.55. The 10-year yield hit its highest level since July 2007 earlier in the week and was around 5.0% on Friday. Traders are weighing the Fed's first hike in three years against elevated oil prices.
news.detailZh: 道指下跌95.40点（0.18%）至51,682.64，标普500上涨0.17%至7,650.50，纳指上涨0.39%至26,522.55。10年期收益率本周早些时候触及2007年7月以来最高水平，周五约为5.0%。交易员正在权衡美联储三年来首次加息与高企的油价。

news.titleEn: Oil prices today: Brent, WTI, Saudi Arabia, Houthi
news.conclusionEn: Oil fell as China asked Iran to curb Houthi attacks on Saudi oil facilities; Brent settled near $105.
news.conclusionZh: 中国要求伊朗约束胡塞武装袭击沙特油设施，油价下跌，布伦特收于105美元附近。
news.whyEn: Crude above $100 feeds inflation and complicates central bank policy globally.
news.whyZh: 油价高于100美元推高通胀，并使各国央行政策更复杂。
news.detailEn: Brent settled at $104.87, down 0.93%, and WTI at $100.30, down 1.58%. China acted on a request from Saudi Arabia to ask Iran to limit Houthi strikes that threaten a second Middle East export route. The Strait of Hormuz remains constrained, with only four commodity vessels passing on Thursday versus a 10-day average of about 16.
news.detailZh: 布伦特原油收于104.87美元，下跌0.93%；WTI收于100.30美元，下跌1.58%。中国应沙特请求，要求伊朗限制胡塞武装对第二条中东出口通道构成威胁的袭击。霍尔木兹海峡仍受限，周四仅有4艘大宗商品船通过，而10日均值约为16艘。

news.titleEn: Pfizer, HHS to Share Revenue in Deal on Overseas Drug Prices
news.conclusionEn: Released documents show HHS gets a share of Pfizer's extra revenue if it charges higher prices abroad.
news.conclusionZh: 公开文件显示，若辉瑞在海外提价，美国卫生部将分享其增收部分。
news.whyEn: It shows how Washington ties lower US drug prices to higher prices overseas.
news.whyZh: 显示美国政府把压低国内药价与提高海外药价挂钩。
news.detailEn: The 'most favored nation' contract was obtained by watchdog Public Citizen through a FOIA lawsuit. The revenue-share percentage and covered medicines are redacted. Related documents indicate the Pfizer and Eli Lilly deals also included undisclosed tariff protections. The White House says the design ensures added income benefits American patients rather than drugmakers.
news.detailZh: 这份「最惠国」合同由监督组织Public Citizen通过信息自由法诉讼获得，分成比例和涉及药品均被涂黑。相关文件显示辉瑞和礼来的协议还包含未公开的关税保护。白宫称这一设计让新增收入惠及美国患者而非药企。

news.titleEn: AI cloud provider Nscale files to go public
news.conclusionEn: London-based AI cloud firm Nscale filed for a NYSE IPO under ticker NSCL, seeking up to $3 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 伦敦AI云服务商Nscale申请在纽交所上市，代码NSCL，拟募资最多30亿美元。
news.whyEn: It is a test of investor appetite for AI infrastructure amid heavy losses.
news.whyZh: 检验投资者在巨额亏损下对AI基础设施的胃口。
news.detailEn: Nscale reported a $1.02 billion net loss on $140.6 million revenue in the first half of 2026, with revenue up 1,252% year on year. Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley lead the offering. OpenAI and Anthropic are customers, including a $45 billion Anthropic agreement for its West Virginia campus.
news.detailZh: 2026年上半年Nscale净亏损10.2亿美元，营收1.406亿美元，同比增长1,252%。高盛、摩根大通和摩根士丹利牵头发行。OpenAI和Anthropic都是客户，包括Anthropic价值450亿美元、涉及西弗吉尼亚园区的协议。

news.titleEn: SpaceX scores another $950 million from NASA for 3 more crewed flights to ISS
news.conclusionEn: NASA added about $946 million for three more SpaceX crewed ISS missions.
news.conclusionZh: NASA追加约9.46亿美元，让SpaceX再执行三次载人空间站任务。
news.whyEn: It deepens NASA's reliance on SpaceX while the company heads toward a possible IPO.
news.whyZh: 加深NASA对SpaceX的依赖，而后者正迈向可能的IPO。
news.detailEn: The modification covers Crew-15, Crew-16 and Crew-17, raising SpaceX's mission count under the contract to 17 and its total value to $5.92 billion. Performance runs through 2030. Crew-13 is expected to launch in October.
news.detailZh: 合同修改涵盖Crew-15、16、17任务，使SpaceX在该合同下的任务总数达17次，总价值增至59.2亿美元，履约期至2030年。Crew-13预计10月发射。

news.titleEn: Nike parts ways with Kylian Mbappé; soccer superstar signs with On
news.conclusionEn: Mbappé left Nike after about 20 years and signed a 10-year deal with Swiss brand On.
news.conclusionZh: 姆巴佩结束与耐克约20年合作，与瑞士品牌On签下10年合约。
news.whyEn: It is a marketing win for challenger On and another setback for Nike.
news.whyZh: 这是挑战者On的营销胜利，也是耐克的又一次打击。
news.detailEn: Nike chose not to renew as the contract expired. The deal, On's first with a soccer player, includes cash and equity, and Mbappé will work with On's product teams on footwear and apparel. It signals On's push into soccer, a market dominated by larger rivals.
news.detailZh: 耐克在合同到期时选择不续约。这是On首次签约足球运动员，包含现金和股权，姆巴佩将参与On鞋服产品开发。此举标志On进军由大品牌主导的足球市场。

news.titleEn: Russian Parliamentary elections: empty podiums, prizes for e-voting, no opposition
news.conclusionEn: Russia began a three-day State Duma vote with the outcome widely expected to favour Kremlin-aligned United Russia.
news.conclusionZh: 俄罗斯开始为期三天的国家杜马选举，普遍预期亲克里姆林宫的统一俄罗斯党胜出。
news.whyEn: It is the first parliamentary vote since the 2022 invasion and includes annexed Ukrainian regions.
news.whyZh: 这是2022年入侵乌克兰后的首次议会选举，且包含被吞并的乌克兰地区。
news.detailEn: Voting runs 18-20 September for 450 seats. Critical opposition is effectively absent, and United Russia polls near 40 percent. For the first time, residents of regions Moscow annexed from Ukraine take part, a move widely condemned as illegal.
news.detailZh: 投票于9月18日至20日举行，争夺450个议席。有力的反对派实际上缺席，统一俄罗斯党支持率约40%。莫斯科吞并的乌克兰地区居民首次参与投票，此举被广泛谴责为非法。

businessTips.explanationEn: Every system's output is limited by its single slowest step, the bottleneck. Improving anything else barely changes total output. Find the constraint, exploit it fully, then move to the next one.
businessTips.explanationZh: 任何系统的产出都受限于最慢的那个环节，即瓶颈。优化其他环节几乎不会提高总产出。先找到瓶颈，充分利用它，再去处理下一个瓶颈。
businessTips.exampleEn: A bakery can bake 100 loaves an hour but decorate only 40. Hiring another baker changes nothing; adding a decorator lifts output toward 100.
businessTips.exampleZh: 面包店每小时能烤100个面包，但只能装饰40个。再请一个烘焙师没用，增加一个装饰师才能把产出提升到接近100个。

businessTips.explanationEn: Unit economics measures profit on a single customer: lifetime value (LTV) minus the cost to acquire them (CAC). A common rule of thumb is LTV should be at least 3x CAC. It tells you whether growing will make or lose money.
businessTips.explanationZh: 单位经济模型衡量单个客户的盈利：客户终身价值（LTV）减去获客成本（CAC）。常见经验是LTV至少为CAC的3倍。它能告诉你规模扩大后是赚钱还是亏钱。
businessTips.exampleEn: If a side-business spends $30 on ads per customer who then spends $60 in total, it barely breaks even after costs. Fix pricing or retention before scaling ad spend.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果副业每获得一个客户花30美元广告费，而客户总共只消费60美元，扣除成本后几乎不赚钱。应先改进定价或复购，再加大广告投入。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration estimates how much a bond's price falls when interest rates rise. The longer the duration, the bigger the loss per percentage point increase in yields. It is why long-dated bonds suffer most in a rate-hiking cycle.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期用来估算利率上升时债券价格的下跌幅度。久期越长，收益率每上升一个百分点，损失越大。这就是加息周期中长期债券受伤最重的原因。
businessTips.exampleEn: A bond fund with a duration of 8 years would lose roughly 8% in value if yields rose 1 percentage point. Investors worried about rising yields often shorten duration.
businessTips.exampleZh: 久期为8年的债券基金，若收益率上升1个百分点，价值大约下跌8%。担心收益率上升的投资者常会缩短组合久期。
